application.stage: after canonical mono 44100 Hz audio, before feature extraction or playback PCM encoding
application.selection: all clips, independent of DC flag
application.qa: measure DC, RMS, peak and clipping before and after filtering; do not silently clip or normalize

policy.limits: An engineering choice for the current rendering protocol. Not a formal perceptual equivalence result, descriptor validation, or full-domain coverage claim. Loudness normalization and final parameter bounds are separate decisions.

level_policy.method: constant gain per clip; no compression, fades or peak normalization

selection.method: greedy maximin: equally weighted parameter/acoustic blocks
selection.note: Diversity heuristic, not perceptual or full-domain coverage

assignment_plan.note: Issue in block order and fill missing blocks. Prefix balance is not a full BIBD. No within-listener repeatability estimate.

rehearsal_note: Supervisor review only; pending approval, excluded from research analysis.
